profile.headline: Software Development Engineer
profile.summary:
Accomplished Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience developing and optimizing software solutions for automotive applications, including ADAS, infotainment, and embedded systems. Strong expertise in software development, real-time data processing, and UI/UX design for vehicle displays. Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-performance, scalable, and innovative solutions that enhance safety, performance, and user experience. Adept at debugging, system integration, and improving software efficiency.
Graduate student in Computer Engineering with a specialization in Software and Machine Intelligence.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: East Liberty, Ohio, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Developed 3D Meter and HUD (Heads-Up Display) models in Unity, converting existing Kanzi HMI models and enhancing user interface visualization.
•Engineered a 3D road model using Catmull-Rom spline interpolation, dynamically positioning ego vehicles, traffic objects, and critical ADAS elements such as ALC (Automatic Lane Change) icons, FCTW (Front Cross Traffic Warning), ACC (Adaptive Cruise Control), and LKAS (Lane Keeping Assist System).
•	Designed a UDP-based communication interface between Dspace (MATLAB) and Unity models, eliminating the need for hardware-based interfaces, and improving flexibility and scalability.
•Developed multiple Meter Cluster prototypes in Unity for user feedback testing and incorporated changes based on stakeholder approvals.
•Built a real-time CAN signal interface using a VN1610 device, logging data into CSV format for Unity-based visualization.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
•Designed and implemented an Android/iOS mobile application with augmented reality (AR) for photovoltaic inverter servicing, using YOLOv2/YOLOv3 for part detection.
•Preprocessed image datasets, applying augmentation and lighting variations to enhance object detection accuracy.
•Developed a C#-based data collection and analytics software (SeePort) using .NET libraries for enhanced industrial data processing.
•Built an RTSP server enabling virtual camera interaction with existing monitoring software, optimizing real-time streaming functionalities.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Vision · Real Time Streaming Protocol (RTSP) · Python (Programming Language) · Unity · Android Development

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Worked in Mind Music Machine lab as a computer vision engineer. Enhanced a 7-emotion facial expression detection system for adults and children, improving the SVM-based model with a Capsule Network, achieving 99.3% accuracy using the CK+ dataset.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Assisted freshman students with MATLAB assignments and evaluated their submissions.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Graduate Teaching Assistant for the course "Embedded Systems Design", a senior-level graduating course for Spring. Developed an Echo and Flask server image for Raspberry Pi 3. Worked with MPLAB IDE using the XC8 compiler for embedded system development.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant at TREC Lab
positions.description: Worked as a computer vision engineer. Implemented real-time object detection using the Caffe model. Developed lane detection with the LaneNet model for the autonomous vehicle ‘Turtle,’ used to assess airport ground conditions.

positions.title: Graduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Graduate Teaching Assistant for the course "Applied Software Design", a third-year undergrad course in Fall 2018. Built PlotScript, a scripting language using S-expression semantics.Developed in Visual Studio with Qt for software design applications.

positions.title: Computer Vision Intern
positions.description:
•Implemented real-time Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for port crane ID detection, leveraging the EAST (Efficient and Accurate Scene Text detection) model to improve automation and tracking accuracy.
•Developed a GUI in Tkinter, integrating video/image feeds for seamless OCR detection and verification.
•Enhanced OCR performance using RotNet for automatic image orientation correction, achieving 80% accuracy in detection tasks.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Vision · Machine Learning · Optical Character Recognition (OCR)

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant at Digital Library Research Laboratory (DLRL)
positions.description:
Conducted experiments on dialogue act classifiers, including BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers), CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks), and Bi-directional LSTM (Long Short-Term Memory), using tobacco deposition transcripts to predict dialogue acts for question-answer pairs. Evaluated model performance based on precision, recall, and F1-score, with BERT achieving the highest average F1-score of 84%.
Developed a Python script to convert JSON files to CSV format, enabling seamless parsing of PDF files into JSON and ultimately into CSV.
positions.insights: Skills: Natural Language Processing (NLP) · Machine Learning

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•Designed and developed software modules for Suzuki Instrument Clusters using CubeSuite++, focusing on ADC, EEPROM, fuel monitoring, ignition control, and LCD displays.
•Implemented UART communication for Suzuki Instrument Cluster, improving performance over the existing I2C-based approach.
•Executed comprehensive unit testing in the VectorCAST environment, ensuring software reliability across 25+ modules, leading to a 30% reduction in reported defects during the initial deployment phase
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Systems · C (Programming Language) · Automotive Infotainment · CAN

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer -ADAS
positions.description:
Client: Nissan 
•Developed deep learning models for autonomous driving applications, enhancing traffic sign recognition and lane change assist accuracy by 25%.
•Designed and optimized neural network architectures, including LeNet-5, for improved recognition and detection system performance.
•Conducted requirement-based testing using CAPL scripting in CANoe for Nissan’s Short Range Radar (SRR320NN) project.
•Contributed to Toyota’s Advanced Radar System (ARS) by modifying and optimizing code for regional compatibility and platform integration.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Vision · Machine Learning · CAPL · CANoe · Vector CANalyzer · CAN

projects.title: Abstractive Multi-Document Summarization with Guided Knowledge
projects.description: Developed a knowledge guided encoder-decoder based model to improve the current multi-document summarization system. The model takes each document separately, thereby representing thematic diversity within the corpus. The work helped in illustrating the strengths and weaknesses of the attention-based model and the result was compared with several other baseline methods.

projects.title: Driver Attention Prediction in critical situations
projects.description: Estimate where a person would pay attention to while driving,and which part of the scene around the vehicle is more critical for the task. The multi-branch deep architectures which are used here are Berkeley Deep-Drive Attention, ML-NET and LSTM Saliency Attentive Map Models.  Compared the Avg. MSE (per pixel), Z-norm (per-pixel) and SSIM scores of predicted gaze map with reference to groundtruth fixation map. Berkeley Deep-Drive Attention model performed better in terms of identifying critical situations on the road as compared to the other models.

publications.title: Comparative analysis of facial affect detection algorithms
publications.publisher: Proceedings of 2020 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC2020) · Oct 14, 2020

publications.title: Collection Management Tobacco Settlement Documents (CMT) CS5604 Fall 2019

organizations.name: NSS(National Service Scheme)
organizations.description: Got National level certificates for active participation in various NSS (National Service Scheme) activities like visiting orphanages, old age homes, plantation drive and teaching at a community school.
